steps.name: precheck-existing-spire-1m-reloptions
command: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS ecaz; SELECT now() AS captured_at, current_database() AS database_name, version() AS postgres_version; SELECT count(*) AS corpus_rows FROM task67_1m_hnsw_m7g2xlarge_corpus; SELECT count(*) AS query_rows FROM task67_1m_hnsw_m7g2xlarge_queries; SELECT i.relname AS index_name, am.amname, pg_size_pretty(pg_relation_size(i.oid)) AS index_size, x.indoption, i.reloptions FROM pg_index x JOIN pg_class i ON i.oid = x.indexrelid JOIN pg_class t ON t.oid = x.indrelid JOIN pg_am am ON am.oid = i.relam WHERE t.relname = 'task67_1m_hnsw_m7g2xlarge_corpus' ORDER BY i.relname;
